question: What is the site's OPEN-ground datum if cover is a covariate to be removed and every flight line keeps its own offset?

inputs.role: per-mark ties with the line their returns assign and their MnDNR cover class
each line's share of the ground cells the pipeline built for this tile

params.name: model
params.why: an interaction would need a mark in every line x cover cell; there are 6 lines and 6 covers against 25 marks, so it is not estimable

params.name: reference_cover
params.why: set to zero, so the intercept plus each line effect IS that line's OPEN-ground level and the datum is read out there

params.name: max_km
params.why: optional restriction to the near field; None uses every mark

columns.term: model coefficient: the intercept (reference line at reference cover), a line offset, or a cover effect relative to the reference cover; all in mm
columns.w: that line's share of the tile's ground cells, 0-1
columns.open_level_mm: mu + L_i, that line's OPEN-ground datum, mm

headline: open-ground datum +72.08 +/- 36.99 mm from 25 marks, cover removed as a covariate
